item.title: Plane Crash In Northern Colombia Kills All 15 On Board, Including Lawmaker And Election Candidate
item.description: A passenger plane crashes in northern Colombia, killing all 15 on board as wreckage is found in mountainous terrain.

item.title: Tinubu Mourns Otunba Adekunle Ojora
item.description: President Tinubu mourns influential industrialist and Lagos royal Otunba Adekunle Ojora who died on Wednesday at the age of 93.

item.title: Nicki Minaj Declares Loyalty To Trump, Says She’s His ‘No. 1 Fan’ At US Treasury Event In Washington
item.description: Nicki Minaj publicly backs President Trump in Washington, vowing support and pledging funds for children’s “Trump accounts” initiative.

item.title: Oyedele: FG Won’t Compromise Nigeria’s Future For Those Who Benefited Without Paying Taxes For Years
item.description: Presidential Tax Reforms Committee Chairman, Taiwo Oyedele, says tax resistance comes from people who benefited for years without paying taxes.

item.title: Meta To Nearly Double AI Spending In 2026 Amid Push For Industry Transformation
item.description: Meta plans to nearly double AI spending to $135bn in 2026, aiming to boost productivity and transform its operations.

item.title: Naira Hits N1,400/$ For First Time Since May 2024 As Currency Strengthens In Official Market
item.description: Naira has hit N1,400 against the dollar for first time since May 2024, boosted by rising FX reserves, stronger market confidence.

item.title: Umo Eno Questions Contractor Over Mortuary Plan At Hospital Site
item.description: Akwa Ibom Governor Umo Eno drew attention online after rejecting a mortuary-first plan during his inspection of Ikot Ekpene Udo General Hospital.

item.title: Oil Resumption: FG Urged to Ensure Equitable Distribution of Ogoni Appointments
item.description: Ogoni leader calls for fair spread of federal appointments across four LGAs ahead of oil exploration resumption.

item.title: Satchet Alcohol Ban Not Punitive But Protective, NAFDAC Insists
item.description: NAFDAC says sachet alcohol ban protects children and youth, insisting enforcement targets packaging, not companies or producers.

item.title: Ajayi-Kadir: Sachet Alcohol Ban Will Be Counterproductive, Threaten Jobs And Fuel Illicit Trade
item.description: MAN DG Ajayi-Kadir warns satchet alcohol ban will cost jobs, cut revenue and worsen public health through unregulated alcohol markets.
